title: 第25章 寒冰体第26章 苍龙体帝境残魂
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
………………
在江道心弄吃的这段时间。
江尘也没有闲着。
而是直接回到了自己的房间之中，开始修炼起了《混沌造化诀》。
……
云家。
某女子闺房中。
咯吱——
房门打开。
云惜雪迈步从房间中走去。
门口丫鬟看到她的身影后。
当即恭敬开口：“小姐好！”
云惜雪：“嗯，我父亲呢？”
丫鬟：“小姐，今天百宝阁中有一场拍卖会，家主他已经带人过去了。”
拍卖会吗！
沉吟了一会。
云惜雪再次开口：“对了，我闭关这段时间，江家那边可有什么反应？”
提到江家时。
云惜雪目光中闪过了一抹冷光。
虽然有落云宗在上面压着，外界都不敢轻易议论自己，都认为是江宇被退婚。

在他们能看。
所谓的休妻。
不过是江家为了保留颜面，才故意传出休妻的消息而已。
可云惜雪却十分清楚。
自己确实是被江宇那个废物给休了。
丫鬟：“小姐，你闭关之后，江家一直都很低调，如同什么事都没发生一般。”
“不仅如此，伴随着云家与其余两大世家的不断针对，江家情况变得越来越糟，要不了多久就能实行下一步计划了。”
一听这话。
云惜雪神情并没有太大变化。
轻轻点了点头。
开口说道：“好，我知道了！”
话音落下。
云惜雪迈步朝着大殿方向走去。
其实。
云惜雪原本可以直接去落云宗，但她并没有那么做。
之所以选择留下。
则是想在万众瞩目下加入落云宗。
对她来说。
所谓的考核不过是一个过场而已。
之所以选这种方式。

一是为了震慑其他势力。
让他们知道云家有人加入落云宗。
从而不敢轻易对其动手。
content_en:
………………
During the time when I was eating at Jiang Dao Xin Nong.
Jiang Chen was not idle either.
Instead, he returned directly to his room and began to practice the "Chaos Creation Technique".
…
Yun family.
In a woman's boudoir.
Creak——
The door opens.
Yun Xixue walked out of the room.
The maid at the door saw her figure.
He immediately said respectfully: "Hello, Miss!"
Yun Xixue: "Well, where is my father?"
Maid: "Miss, there is an auction in the Baibao Pavilion today. The master of the house has already taken people there."
Auction?
He pondered for a while.
Yun Xixue spoke again: "By the way, during the time I was in seclusion, what was the reaction from the Jiang family?"
When it comes to the Jiang family.
A cold light flashed in Yun Xixue's eyes.
Although the Luo Yun Sect was suppressing him, the outside world did not dare to talk about him easily, and they all believed that Jiang Yu's engagement was annulled.
As far as they can see.
The so-called divorce.
It was just that the Jiang family deliberately spread the news of divorcing their wife in order to save face.
But Yun Xixue knew it very well.
He was indeed divorced by that good-for-nothing Jiang Yu.
Maid: "Miss, after you went into seclusion, the Jiang family has always kept a low profile, as if nothing happened."
"Not only that, with the continuous targeting of the Yun family and the other two major families, the situation of the Jiang family is getting worse and worse. It won't be long before the next plan can be implemented."
Upon hearing this.
Yun Xixue's expression didn't change much.
He nodded slightly.
He said, "Okay, I get it!"
The words fell.
Yun Xixue walked towards the main hall.
actually.
Yun Xixue could have gone directly to Luoyun Sect, but she did not do that.
The reason why I chose to stay.
He wanted to join the Luoyun Sect under the spotlight.
To her.
The so-called assessment is just a formality.
The reason for choosing this method.
One is to deter other forces.
Let them know that someone from the Yun family has joined the Luoyun Sect.
So they dare not do anything to them easily.
